publisher: Massachusetts Secretary of the Commonwealth, Corporations Division
reassessment_reason: Pin the paid-extract regulation separately from website restrictions, and explicitly retain the ambiguity of the stated monthly/weekly delivery cadence.

access.bulk: 950 CMR 113.15(3) describes a full extract available monthly in weekly increments, with data elements and layout obtainable from the filing office.
access.api: The website offers individual business search; no supported public business-entity bulk API was established.
access.fees: Published regulation: $4,800/year or $100/week for data. Separate image fees do not apply to the desired entity projection. Current fulfillment quote unverified.

fields.summary: Public search distinguishes nine-digit Identification Number from Filing Number. Presence, stability and lifecycle of these identifiers in the extract remain unverified; the field layout is on request.

active_status_semantics: Administrative filing status must remain separate from operating activity. No current extract status dictionary or active-only scope established.
statewide_completeness: The regulation concerns corporate system data, but exact paid-product entity-type and historical scope remain unresolved; statewide_complete=false.
address_zip: Principal-office, registered-office and person-linked addresses require role-specific handling. Preserve ZIP5 and ZIP4 separately; do not assume an entity office is a physical business site.
automation_terms_fees: Website terms explicitly prohibit both manual and automated scraping/crawling. The existence of a paid bulk product does not authorize website collection; supported paid-extract transport must be separately established.
redistribution: Website terms restrict derivative activity, while product-specific paid-extract retention and derived-publication rights remain unresolved. No broad reuse license is inferred.
temporal_refresh: The regulation's monthly availability in weekly increments does not specify whether each delivery is a complete snapshot or delta, how a baseline is delivered, or how deletions and corrections are replayed.

citations.evidence: Section 113.15(3), page 7: extract pricing, stated cadence and schema-on-request.
Acceptable-use scope and explicit manual/automated scraping restriction.
Search metadata distinguishes nine-digit Identification Number and Filing Number; no query submitted.

strongest_next_action: Obtain the paid product's schema-only layout and agreement first, then resolve full snapshot versus incremental semantics, baseline, deletions/replay, type/status/address definitions, stable identifiers, delivery and derived-use scope. This assessment authorizes no contact, purchase, search enumeration or connector.
